from openpyxl import load_workbook
import re

# Load the workbook
file_path = '/Users/shashankbhat/Projects/compiler_project/demo/runs/live-haiku/t5_rename_sheet__default__3/book.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(file_path)

# Step 1: Rename the sheet
old_name = 'Sales'
new_name = 'Q3 Sales'
sheet = wb[old_name]
sheet.title = new_name

# Step 2: Update all formulas in all sheets that reference the old sheet name
for sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    sheet = wb[sheet_name]
    for row in sheet.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            if cell.value and isinstance(cell.value, str) and cell.value.startswith('='):
                # Replace references to 'Sales!' with 'Q3 Sales!'
                # Need to be careful with the syntax - Excel uses 'Sheet Name'! for sheet names with spaces
                updated_formula = re.sub(r'\bSales!', "'Q3 Sales'!", cell.value)
                if updated_formula != cell.value:
                    cell.value = updated_formula
                    print(f"Updated formula in {sheet_name}!{cell.coordinate}: {updated_formula}")

# Step 3: Update named ranges that reference the old sheet name
for name in wb.defined_names:
    defn = wb.defined_names[name]
    if 'Sales!' in defn.value:
        old_value = defn.value
        new_value = old_value.replace('Sales!', "'Q3 Sales'!")
        defn.value = new_value
        print(f"Updated named range '{name}': {old_value} -> {new_value}")

# Step 4: Save the workbook
wb.save(file_path)
print(f"\nWorkbook saved successfully to {file_path}")

EOF
